answer: Every identity starts by locking a fixed native-token bond as a slashable bond, so creating one costs real money. Proof of grading peers far from the panel verdict comes from grading-consensus scoring. Once the fault is proven, the slash doubles for each repeat offence within sixteen epochs. A bond without a mirror behind it is just an username. Only a signal bond counts toward admission, and fakes must post one each. Without a ledge of fresh stake, a new identity cannot register.
